mapper.sql: left join kb_billing_rule_versions bv on bv.id = ( select v.id from kb_billing_rule_versions v where v.rule_code = br.code order by (v.status = 1) desc, v.effective_from desc, v.id desc limit 1 )

left join ks_enum_categories ecf on ecf.category = 'model_family' and ecf.is_deleted = 0 left join ks_enum_configs ef on ef.category_id = ecf.id and ef.item_code = br.model_family and ef.is_deleted = 0

br.id, br.code, br.model_family as model_family_code, ef.item_label as model_family_name, br.status, br.is_deleted, br.remark, bv.version_code, bv.uniq_hash, bv.billing_mode, bv.pricing_plan, bv.currency, bv.unit, bv.status as version_status, bv.config_json, bv.effective_from, bv.effective_to, (select count(1) from kb_models m where m.billing_rule_code = br.code and m.is_deleted = 0) as bound_model_count

br.id, br.code, br.model_family as model_family_code, ef.item_label as model_family_name, br.status, bv.version_code, bv.billing_mode, bv.pricing_plan, bv.currency, bv.unit, (select count(1) from kb_models m where m.billing_rule_code = br.code and m.is_deleted = 0) as bound_model_count
mapper.select:
select from kb_billing_rules br
br.is_deleted = 0
and ( br.code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ef.item_label like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or br.model_family like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
and (br.model_family = #{modelFamilyCode} or br.model_family is null)
and br.code = #{code}
order by br.is_deleted asc, br.id desc

select from kb_billing_rules br
where br.is_deleted = 0 order by br.id

select from kb_billing_rules br
where br.id = #{id} and br.is_deleted = 0

select from kb_billing_rules br
where br.code = #{code} and br.is_deleted = 0
select count(1) from kb_models where billing_rule_code = #{code} and is_deleted = 0

select from kb_billing_rules br inner join kb_billing_rule_versions bv on br.code = bv.rule_code
where br.code = #{ruleCode} and br.is_deleted = 0 and br.status = 1 and bv.status = 1 and bv.effective_from <= #{effectiveAt} and (bv.effective_to is null or bv.effective_to > #{effectiveAt}) order by bv.effective_from desc, bv.id desc limit 1

select from kb_billing_rules br inner join kb_billing_rule_versions bv on br.code = bv.rule_code
where br.is_deleted = 0 and br.status = 1 and bv.status = 1 and bv.effective_from <= #{effectiveAt} and (bv.effective_to is null or bv.effective_to > #{effectiveAt}) and (br.model_family = #{modelFamilyCode} or br.model_family is null) order by (br.model_family is null) asc, bv.effective_from desc, bv.id desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into kb_billing_rules(code, model_family, status, remark) values(#{code}, #{modelFamilyCode}, #{status}, #{remark})
mapper.update: update kb_billing_rules set is_deleted = 1, status = 0 where id = #{id} and is_deleted = 0
update kb_billing_rules set is_deleted = 0 where id = #{id} and is_deleted = 1
mapper.select: select id, rule_code, version_code, uniq_hash, billing_mode, pricing_plan, currency, unit, config_json, status, effective_from, effective_to from kb_billing_rule_versions where rule_code = #{ruleCode} order by effective_from desc, id desc limit 1
select coalesce(max(cast(substring(version_code, 2) as unsigned)), 0) from kb_billing_rule_versions where rule_code = #{ruleCode} and version_code like 'v%'
mapper.insert: insert into kb_billing_rule_versions(rule_code, version_code, uniq_hash, billing_mode, pricing_plan, currency, unit, config_json, status, effective_from, effective_to) values(#{ruleCode}, #{versionCode}, #{uniqHash}, #{billingMode}, #{pricingPlan}, #{currency}, #{unit}, #{configJson}, #{status}, #{effectiveFrom}, #{effectiveTo})
mapper.update: update kb_billing_rule_versions set uniq_hash = #{uniqHash}, billing_mode = #{billingMode}, pricing_plan = #{pricingPlan}, currency = #{currency}, unit = #{unit}, config_json = #{configJson}, status = #{status}, effective_from = #{effectiveFrom}, effective_to = #{effectiveTo} where id = #{id}
